item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day has a lot of reminders about patterns, perspective, and staying present. Water supports all of that. Even mild dehydration dulls focus and mood, which makes it harder to catch negative thinking and respond with grace. Pair it with routines you already have: a glass before the morning meditation, one before the afternoon walk, one before the evening wind-down. Action: pour a full glass of water right now and finish it.
